<!--
  The projects of ProjectGrid as tiles: cards (picture, featured badge, category and year, title, summary, tags,
  two links), compact cards in four columns, captions over the pictures, or a bento where the first project
  takes a big tile.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Project, ProjectLabels } from "../blocks/project-grid.types";

  export type ProjectTilesProps = {
    projects: Project[];
    labels: ProjectLabels;
    layout?: "cards" | "compact" | "overlay" | "bento" | "list";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Badge from "../primitives/badge/badge.svelte";
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import Link from "../primitives/link/link.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import Title from "../primitives/title/title.svelte";
  import ArticleBlock from "../components/article-block.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

  let { projects, labels, layout = "cards" }: ProjectTilesProps = $props();
  const over = $derived(
    (layout as string) === "overlay" ? true
    : ((layout as string) === "bento")
  );
</script>

<Box
  class={
    (layout as string) === "compact" ? "grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4"
    : "grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3"
  }
  data-testid="items"
>
  {#each projects as p, i (p.id)}
    <ArticleBlock
      class={cn(
        "flex flex-col gap-4",
        (over ? "relative" : "rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-4"),
        ((((layout as string) === "bento") && (i === 0)) ? "sm:col-span-2 lg:row-span-2" : "")
      )}
      testid="item"
    >
      <Box class={(over ? "h-full" : "relative")}>
        <MediaFrame
          alt={p.title}
          ratio={(((layout as string) === "compact") ? "1/1" : (over ? "3/4" : "4/3"))}
          class={(over ? "h-full" : "")}
        />
        {#if (p.featured && ((layout as string) !== "compact"))}
          <Badge variant="default" size="default" class="absolute left-4 top-4" data-testid="featured">
            {labels.featured}
          </Badge>
        {/if}
      </Box>
      <Stack
        gap="2"
        align="stretch"
        class={(over ? "absolute right-4 bottom-4 left-4 rounded bg-background p-4" : "")}
      >
        <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {tpl("{0}, {1}", p.category, p.year)}
        </Text>
        <Title as={3} size={(((layout as string) === "compact") ? "sm" : "lg")} weight="semibold">
          {p.title}
        </Title>
        {#if ((layout as string) !== "compact")}
          <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {p.summary}
          </Text>
        {/if}
        {#if ((layout as string) === "cards")}
          <Group gap="2" class="flex-wrap">
            {#each p.tags as k (k)}
              <Badge variant="secondary" size="sm">
                {k}
              </Badge>
            {/each}
          </Group>
          <Group gap="4" class="pt-2">
            <Link href="#/work" variant="default" class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium">
              {labels.case}
              <LucideIcon name="arrow-right" size={16} />
            </Link>
            <Link href="#/work" variant="default" class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium">
              {labels.view}
              <LucideIcon name="external-link" size={16} />
            </Link>
          </Group>
        {/if}
      </Stack>
    </ArticleBlock>
  {/each}
</Box>
